label: The Dry Country
summary: A dust-blown wasteland of dead highways and walled settlements, forty years after the Collapse.

world.setting: The Dry Country, a wasteland of dead highways and walled settlements
world.description: Water is money, fuel is power, and the old cities are ruins full of useful junk and worse things. Settlements trade, raid and make uneasy truces along the last working highway.
rules: No magic: the dangers are people, weather and scarcity
Water, fuel and ammunition are scarce and always counted
Trust is earned slowly and lost in a moment
